title: Vertex AI Pricing: Costs by Service (2026 Guide)
summary: Vertex AI pricing charges per service with no monthly seats or tiers. You can estimate costs based on tokens, characters, seconds, or node-hours consumed.
body_markdown:
## Charges hiding in Vertex AI bills


Even with caching missed, other charges apply, and each can move the bill more than the headline input rate does.

### Output and thinking tokens


When a reasoning model gives a one-line answer, the hidden bill can still be long, because **thinking tokens are billed as output** . Before launch, compare billed output tokens against the visible reply length in your logs.


Past 1,500 prompts a day, grounding starts to cost: Grounding with Google Search is free for the first 1,500 prompts a day, then **$35 per 1,000** . The chart shows how flat the line is until that threshold and how steeply it climbs afterward.


A feature that grounds 5,000 prompts daily pays for 3,500 of them, or $122.50 a day.


### Always-on charges: endpoints, indexes, provisioned throughput


**A deployed endpoint bills node-hours whether or not anyone calls it.** According to[c3x.dev](https://c3x.dev/resources/gcp/google_vertex_ai_endpoint/) , an n1-standard-2 costs $0.05 an hour, which is small enough to forget.


> **A deployed endpoint bills node-hours whether or not anyone calls it.


It stops being small quickly. c3x.dev lists a 4 vCPU machine with a T4 GPU at $0.45 an hour, and 8 vCPU with a V100 at $2.65.


At 16 vCPU with two A100s, the rate is **$11 an hour** , or about $264 a day for an idle test deploy. Vector Search index serving and Provisioned Throughput bill on the same reserved-capacity logic.


[TokenCost](https://tokencost.app/blog/gemini-3-7-flash-pricing) reports that a Gemini Flash model launched in July 2026 at $1.50 per 1M input tokens. It dropped to $0.75 for August through December, then returns to $1.50 in January 2027.


A budget built on the promo rate will double on input without any change in usage.


When data leaves Google Cloud it incurs egress, and verbose request logging bills for log storage. Both sit outside the Vertex line item, so check the whole project invoice, not just the AI service.
